import re

df = pd.read_csv("/app/dataset/data.csv")
amounts = df["amount_str"].dropna().unique()

for a in amounts:
    s = a.replace("C1", "").replace("C2", "")
    s = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z\s()\-]", "", s)
    has_dot = "." in s
    has_comma = "," in s
    if (has_dot and not has_comma):
